name: Clatter
body:
The marionette has developed a way to mimic the vocal requirements of a spell with the clatter of his movements.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1, marionette

Benefit(s): You may cast spells without a voice. Your clatter still becomes silenced within silent fields.
